# HIZARC Games

> HIZARC Games (also written Hizarc Games) is the game studio of HIZARC, a technology company from Calicut (Kozhikode), Kerala, India. The studio builds original games for mobile, PC, web, console and XR (AR/VR) in Unity and Unreal Engine, and co-develops games with brands and publishers worldwide. Official website: https://hizarc.com

- Name: HIZARC Games
- Website: https://hizarc.com
- Parent company: HIZARC (https://dev.hizarc.com)
- Location: Calicut (Kozhikode), Kerala, India
- Engines: Unity, Unreal Engine
- Platforms: iOS, Android, PC, Web / WebGL, Console, AR / VR
- Contact: shainal@hizarc.com

## Games

- [DEPTH CITY](https://depthcity.hizarc.com/): open-world city building game with an avatar Mayor mode and war, for Android, iOS and PC. Coming soon. Made by HIZARC Games in Unity.

## Website sections

- [Home](https://hizarc.com/): studio overview and headline
- [Games](https://hizarc.com/#games): released games and partner projects
- [Upcoming](https://hizarc.com/#upcoming): games in development
- [Arcade](https://hizarc.com/#arcade): a free browser mini-game, HIZARC DASH
- [Studio](https://hizarc.com/#studio): who we are, what we build, engines and careers
- [Contact](https://hizarc.com/#contact): partnerships, publishing, co-development, press, careers and player support
